snippet.title: After the Wane — Teaser (English)
snippet.description:
Wishlist After the Wane on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742720/After_the_Wane/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=teaser&utm_content=EN

By the creators of Along the Edge and Across the Grooves.

Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

Follow us on social media so you don't miss a thing!
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/PeXpAuFJJZ
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/novabox/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/nova-box.com 
Newsletter: https://mailchi.mp/23dac6383eb5/novaboxnewsletter
Official website: https://afterthewane.nova-box.com/

English voice over: Giana Luna 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/giana_luna_/?hl=en
Twitch:  https://www.twitch.tv/giana_luna_

Choreography: Wyllia Lapouge
Dancers: Wyllia Lapouge & Claire Fontanier
